notes: Access: same intermittent PerimeterX behaviour documented for Bestsellers/Clearance on this company; all needed pages eventually fetched via curl_cffi profile brute-forcing + retries. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow and does not block /daily-sales/ or /curated/ (only /daily-sales/master specifically). No bare '/new-arrivals' or '/curated/new-arrivals' overarching listing exists anywhere on the site (confirmed absent from both the hub's own payload and the full sitewide nav dump), so unlike Joss & Main (which has a single 'All New Arrivals' roll-up page in this project) or AllModern (which has an independently-curated top-level page), wayfair.co.uk exposes New Arrivals ONLY as a set of genuine, real, distinct department/product-type cuts with no single summary page to treat as a parent -- so all rows below are kept as siblings, consistent with the brief's guidance for non-summing coexisting cuts. Two tiers of genuine children were found and each opened individually, confirmed as a real BlockBuilderBrowseTitleEvent PLP (pageKey 'Event', pageType 'Search-Browse', eventRoadsign matching the tile's own name, evergreen eventEndTime of 2029-2200) with matching resultCount/browseResultCount/totalSKUCount: (1) 10 department-level tiles surfaced in the 'New' mega-menu's own NavigationMarketingImageSection (New Outdoor Furniture, New Bedroom Furniture, New Living Room Furniture, New Kitchen & Dining Furniture, New Rugs, New Textiles & Bedding, New Décor, New Lighting, New Kitchenware & Tableware, New Home Office Furniture); (2) 7 more specific product-type tiles surfaced in the site's full accessible nav-link dump under their respective category menus (New-In Accent Chairs, New-In Chests of Drawers, New-In Dining Chairs, New-In Flush Mounts, New-In Wall Art, New-In Duvet Covers, New-In Rugs). Confirmed 'New Rugs' (89 items) and 'New-In Rugs' (490 items) are genuinely different, non-alias listings -- distinct event IDs (ev552039 vs ev550083) and materially different counts, both kept per the overlap-is-expected rule. All /daily-sales/*~e<id>.html links found in nav canonicalize (same content, confirmed via each page's own currentURL tracking field) to a cleaner /curated/*~ev<id2>.html URL -- the canonical /curated/ URL is recorded as link for every row. Checked and excluded from this set: the /daily-sales hub's ~40 other curated tiles ('Our Best Cat Trees', 'Top Rated Wall Art', 'Our Top Sofas', 'Wayfair Verified: X', etc.) -- these are generic 'top-rated'/'best-picks'/'verified' merchandising concepts, not New Arrivals (no 'new' framing in their own title or eventRoadsign). New-In Wall Art's large count (10787) was specifically double-checked against its own page (not a mis-resolved category page) -- its eventRoadsign is literally 'New-In Wall Art' with a genuine curated-event pageType, just a large pool because Wall Art is one of the site's biggest categories.
